FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'My name is Njeri.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Et toi ?
   B. Au revoir, Monsieur.
   C. Je m'appelle Njeri.
   D. Ça s'écrit comment ?

2. How do you say 'My brother is called Kamau.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est mon frère.
   B. J'ai un frère et une sœur.
   C. Voici mon grand-père.
   D. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.

3. How do you say 'My mother is called Grace.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.
   B. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.
   C. C'est ma sœur.
   D. C'est le bébé.

4. What does 'Qui est-ce ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Who is it?
   B. the father
   C. the girl
   D. the sister

5. How do you say 'It is a bed.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. La télé est dans le salon.
   B. C'est un lit.
   C. Le tapis est devant le canapé.
   D. Le livre est sur la table.

6. What does 'dans' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. on
   B. behind
   C. in
   D. under

7. What does 'Mets' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Put
   B. the bedroom
   C. the bag
   D. the shower

8. Which month is 'février'? (1 mark)
   A. April
   B. January
   C. February
   D. May

9. What does 'un gâteau' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a month
   B. a balloon
   C. a candle
   D. a cake

10. Which month is 'mai'? (1 mark)
   A. August
   B. February
   C. December
   D. May

11. How do you say 'It is good for your health.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est bon pour la santé.
   B. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
   C. C'est une banane.
   D. J'aime la mangue.

12. How do you say 'At midday, I eat rice and beans.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le matin, je mange du pain.
   B. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
   C. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   D. Je bois un jus.

13. How do you say 'I have a mouth.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai une bouche.
   B. Elle a les cheveux longs.
   C. Il a les cheveux courts.
   D. J'ai deux pieds.

14. How do you say 'I have two feet.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai une bouche.
   B. J'ai deux yeux.
   C. J'ai deux pieds.
   D. J'ai deux oreilles.

15. What does 'les yeux' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the head
   B. the back
   C. the eyes
   D. the knee

16. What does 'Il fait beau.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is hot.
   B. It is freezing.
   C. It is cold.
   D. The weather is nice.

17. Which letters say oo in bonjour? (1 mark)
   A. ou
   B. au
   C. oi
   D. on

18. How is ê said in fête? (1 mark)
   A. eh
   B. oo
   C. ee
   D. ay

19. Which little word goes with 'chambre' (the bedroom)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. le

20. What does 'Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today it is Monday.
   B. On Saturday, I play.
   C. On Saturday, I help my mother.
   D. On Friday, I dance.

21. Which little word goes with 'fête'? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. les
   D. le

22. Read: Le matin, je mange du pain et je bois du thé. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots. Le soir, je mange du poisson. Question: What does the speaker eat in the evening? (1 mark)
   A. fish
   B. chicken
   C. cake
   D. bread

23. Which little word goes with 'dos' (the back)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. la

24. What does 'J'ai une bouche.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. She has black hair.
   B. He is tall.
   C. I have ten fingers.
   D. I have a mouth.

25. What does 'Aujourd'hui, il pleut.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I stay in the house.
   B. Today it is raining.
   C. It is snowing.
   D. Tomorrow the weather is nice.

26. Which little word goes with 'neige' (the snow)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. l'
   C. les
   D. le

27. What does 'De rien !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Turn left.
   B. Excuse me, where is the school?
   C. The rug is under the table.
   D. You are welcome!

28. What does 'La télé est sur la table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The TV is on the table.
   B. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   C. The rug is under the table.
   D. Where is the key?

29. What does 'Il est sur la table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The door is next to the window.
   B. Go straight ahead.
   C. Turn left.
   D. It is on the table.

30. How do you say 'no' in French? (1 mark)
   A. non
   B. bonjour
   C. bonsoir
   D. Enchanté

31. How do you say 'the girl' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la fille
   B. la famille
   C. le garçon
   D. le père

32. How do you say 'Who is it?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la famille
   B. Voici
   C. Qui est-ce ?
   D. l'enfant

33. How do you say 'the TV' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la chambre
   B. le canapé
   C. le chat
   D. la télé

34. How do you say 'a party' in French? (1 mark)
   A. une fête
   B. un cadeau
   C. un ballon
   D. un gâteau

35. How do you say 'fruits' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le lait
   B. le poisson
   C. les fruits
   D. la tomate

36. How do you say 'the hair' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'oreille
   B. l'épaule
   C. les cheveux
   D. le nez

37. How do you say 'strong' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il gèle.
   B. le vent
   C. beaucoup
   D. fort

38. How do you say 'the weather' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le temps
   B. la pluie
   C. l'orage
   D. une inondation

39. How do you say 'Go' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Allez
   B. Tournez
   C. De rien
   D. Excusez-moi

40. How do you say 'Excuse me' in French? (1 mark)
   A. De rien
   B. Excusez-moi
   C. Tournez
   D. Allez

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into French: 'My birthday is on 30 June.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'Enchanté !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'Yes, I am fine.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'Il neige.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Write three sentences in French about what you do on different days. (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'It is on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'Il fait chaud.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'Here is my family.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Write the months from juillet to décembre in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

51. Translate into French: 'It is good for your health.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Translate into English: 'Le sac est dans la chambre.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into English: 'Je mange une mangue.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Translate into English: 'Merci beaucoup !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

55. Translate into French: 'Turn left.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

56. Translate into English: 'Il y a un orage.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into French: 'This is my brother.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Translate into French: 'I have two feet.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

59. Write a short greeting dialogue of four lines in French between two friends who meet in the morning. Include their names. (4 marks) (4 marks)

60. Translate into English: 'Elle est sous la chaise.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

61. Translate into French: 'The fridge is in the kitchen.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

62. Write a five-line greeting card to a friend called Kamau in French. (5 marks) (5 marks)

SECTION A

1. C — Je m'appelle Njeri.
   My name is Njeri. in French is Je m'appelle Njeri.

2. D — Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.

4. A — Who is it?

34. A — une fête
   a party in French is une fête.

35. C — les fruits
   fruits in French is les fruits.

36. C — les cheveux
   the hair in French is les cheveux.

37. D — fort
   strong in French is fort.

38. A — le temps
   the weather in French is le temps.

39. A — Allez
   Go in French is Allez.

40. B — Excusez-moi
   Excuse me in French is Excusez-moi.
